crumb: Campaign Media Kit · Storyboard · Quest B · Chengdu Panda Base
h1: From watching the cam to meeting the family
slogan: Adopt the family. Collect the fun.
premise: The fan journey runs from ambient live-cam affection to a named panda your household adopts, a season of drops you collect together, and a trip to meet the family in Chengdu.
one_liner: The world's most-loved animal — now part of your family.

facts.c: of live-cam viewers are outside China

chapters.name: The Hook
chapters.blurb: Ambient panda love becomes a reason to belong.

chapters.name: The Offer
chapters.blurb: Adopt a named panda; make it the whole household's.

chapters.name: Belonging
chapters.blurb: Collect the season together; meet the family in Chengdu.

steps.title: A million viewers, no way to belong
steps.scene: a household watching the always-on panda cam together, a warm glow from the shared screen
steps.quote: We've watched them for years. I just wish there was a way to actually be part of it.
steps.action: Turn ambient affection into a membership front door

meta.goal: Recognise the audience and open a door

ui.title: You have watched them for years
lines: Now meet the family that already feels yours

steps.title: The trip suddenly feels possible
steps.scene: a parent planning the Chengdu trip on a phone, visa-free, beside a child
steps.quote: The moment it stopped being a far-away dream was when the visa went away.
steps.action: Meet the trip at the booking moment

meta.goal: Capture trip intent before the OTA booking

steps.title: Adopt a panda of your own
steps.scene: an adopted panda portrait beside a numbered family certificate, confetti in the air
steps.quote: We didn't buy merchandise. We adopted someone.
steps.source: Licensing International 2026 · 77% of character revenue is classic IP

meta.goal: Convert affection into a paid membership

ui.title: Meet your panda
lines: A named panda · the members' cam

steps.title: One joyful membership for the house
steps.scene: a family agreeing around one tablet at home, the household tier on screen
steps.quote: One membership for all of us felt generous — that's what made it easy.
steps.action: Sell the household tier, not a single seat

meta.goal: Lift average order value to the household tier

steps.title: The drop the family collects together
steps.scene: a household opening a numbered seasonal card drop, confetti, kids reaching in
steps.quote: The drop is the reason we come back every season — together.
steps.action: Recur the season — the drop is the retention engine

meta.goal: Drive repeat engagement and drop sell-through

steps.title: Meet the family in Chengdu
steps.scene: the family meeting a real giant panda at the Base, joyful reunion, cameras up
steps.quote: After a year of watching, standing there in person made it real.
steps.action: Bundle the trip to convert belonging into travel
steps.source: Plan capture · Family Trip +$99 at the OTA moment

meta.goal: Turn membership into shared memory and referrals

ui.title: Meet the family
lines: Bundled at the OTA booking moment
